	<header class="entry-header">
		<h2 class="entry-title"><b>Koh Phangan</b></h2><div class="title-border"></div>        <img width="640" height="480" src="https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/KOH-PHANGAN.jpg" class="attachment-post-thumbnail size-post-thumbnail wp-post-image" alt="" decoding="async" srcset="https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/KOH-PHANGAN.jpg 640w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/KOH-PHANGAN-600x450.jpg 600w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/KOH-PHANGAN-300x225.jpg 300w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/KOH-PHANGAN-364x273.jpg 364w" sizes="(max-width: 640px) 100vw, 640px" />		<div class="entry-meta">
			<span class="posted-on">Posted on <a href="https://www.kitethailand.com/2018/06/19/kiteboarding-koh-phangan/" rel="bookmark"><time class="entry-date published" datetime="2018-06-19T07:06:45+00:00">June 19, 2018</time><time class="updated" datetime="2019-03-28T05:03:12+00:00">March 28, 2019</time></a></span><span class="byline"> by <span class="author vcard"><a class="url fn n" href="https://www.kitethailand.com/author/sam1978/">Eran Forshlager</a></span></span>		</div>
	</header>
	<div class="entry-content">
		<h1><strong>Enjoy the ultimate Koh Phangan kiteboarding experience at our Kiteboarding Asia Koh Phangan center!</strong></h1>
<p>[rl_gallery id=&#8221;671&#8243;]<br />
The beautiful island of Koh Phangan is home to Thailand&#8217;s most pristine &amp; beautiful kite spots. It is located off the Central Gulf Coast of Southern Thailand, about half-way between Koh Samui and Koh Tao. The island is small but has plenty to offer! The Koh Phangan kitesurfing season runs all year – but different locations on the islands are better at different times of the year. We have two locations on the island so that our customers can take advantage of the winds no matter what season it is! In addition to Koh Phangan kiteboarding, there is plenty to do on the island. Koh Phangan is well known for its nightlife, especially the Full and Half Moon Parties. If this isn’t really your scene, the island still has plenty to offer – there is the Thong Sala Night Market, many gorgeous beaches, and other water-based activities like sailing, windsurfing or kayaking. If you want to travel, Koh Tao and Koh Samui are also nearby.</p>
<p>The terrain and conditions in Koh Phangan make it the EASIEST place to learn kiteboarding in Thailand. We currently operate two Kite Thailand Koh Phangan centers. The open location will depend on the Koh Phangan kitesurfing season:</p>
<p>At our Kite Thailand Koh Phangan centers, you can:</p>
<ul>
<li>Book kiteboarding lessons.</li>
<li>Book hydrofoil board lessons.</li>
<li>Rent kiteboarding equipment.</li>
<li>Buy kites, boards, accessories, and all sorts of beachwear.</li>
</ul>
<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 24pt;"><strong>Koh Phangan Kitesurfing</strong><strong> Packages:</strong></span></p>
<p><img decoding="async" class="wp-image-366 aligncenter" src="https://www.sidhusoftwares.net/kba/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/kiteboarding-packages-huahin.jpg" alt="" width="847" height="346" srcset="https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/kiteboarding-packages-huahin.jpg 735w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/kiteboarding-packages-huahin-600x245.jpg 600w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/kiteboarding-packages-huahin-300x122.jpg 300w, https://www.kitethailand.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/kiteboarding-packages-huahin-368x150.jpg 368w" sizes="(max-width: 847px) 100vw, 847px" /></p>

							<a target="_blank" href="tel:+66806000573" class="ptsEditArea ptsInputShell" style="color: #fff;"></a><a target="_blank" href="tel:+66806000573" class="ptsEditArea ptsInputShell" style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-align: center; width: 135.344px;">+66806000573</a>
						</div>
					</div>
					<div class="ptsCell" style="height: 36px;">
						<div class="ptsEl" data-el="table_cell_txt" data-type="txt" style=""><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;" data-mce-style="font-size: 12pt;">REDACTED@kitethailand.com</span></p></div>
					</div>
					<div class="ptsCell" style="height: 35px;">
						<div class="ptsEl" data-el="table_cell_txt" data-type="txt" style=""><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;" data-mce-style="font-size: 12pt;">INSTRUCTOR</span></p></div>
					</div>
				<div class="ptsCell ptsCellAlignLeft" style="height: 228px;">
	<div class="ptsEl" data-el="table_cell_txt" data-type="txt" style=""><p>I am Saam! and I am also one of Kite Thailand's first Thai instructors. My kiteboarding journey began nearly 11 years ago, over this time I learnt so much about the sport itself along with the different wind patterns throughout all Kite Thailand locations.<br>I hold plenty of experience with all sorts of kites; from C-kites to modern bow kites, as well as hybrids, foils and everything in-between! I used to love Freestyle riding but over the years I have slowly went back to 'old school' Freeride as it is less taxing on the knees. I have taught thousands of students from all over the world - I hope I get to teach you next!</p></div>
</div></div>
